name: default_banks
character: Which SoundFont bank a track plays when neither the track nor its instrument preset names one. One ordered list per instrument family: the first bank that is installed and whose audit meets that family's thresholds plays; if none does, the fallback plays, so a machine with only the shipped banks renders exactly as before.
provenance: Thresholds are starting values. The shipped banks measure 0 velocity layers for every orchestral family (docs/REALISM-ENHANCEMENT-PLAN.md section 1b), so a bank only becomes the default by beating that on its own audit file (assets/soundfonts/audit/<bank>.json).

thresholds.note: min_layers: velocity zones behind the family's audit programs (median). min_centroid_ratio: spectral centroid at velocity 120 over velocity 40 for the same note. min_air_db: share of 8-16 kHz power; a floor only, since band-limited samples are a fact about the bank.
